text_block_list.text:
"Ooh... Your stamina and form have become 
so much more refined!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Proof of her daily efforts. Above all, I 
want to show off the brilliance she 
possesses on stage as soon as possible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching <chrname>'s training seemed to give her 
some good inspiration.
